messages:
nora_sales: Heads up — DigiBank wants a POC that forbids US subprocessors at all levels, BYO-KMS, and tenant pinning. They asked for a single "EU-locked" artifact pack: region list, per-subprocessor residency proof, routing clause, and POC delta. Need by Tue EOD.

kai_infra: We can serve in eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-north-1. Note: object storage choices vary by region (AWS/GCS). I'll produce a 1-pager region matrix (latency + storage options).

beth_se: BYO-KMS supported for Dedicated/Private only. Customer must provide KMS ARN + cross-account trust. We wrap with envelope encryption and never import keys. Drafting a minimal runbook (curl + IAM sample) and will call out compliance turnaround (~7 biz days).

omar_presales: Pricing note: EU-lock add-on is +18% for short POC; strict no-US-subproc exception requires reserved capacity and contract addendum, so +30%. I'll produce two quotes: "EU-preferred" and "EU-locked strict".

security_review_bot: Created ticket SR-2026-900: need vendor attestations for monitoring/observability vendors (Datadog, Sentry) and proof of in-region support. Also flag: customer requires "no non-EU human access" to logs — needs legal/technical design.

lina_legal: If DigiBank requires absolute ban on non-EU vendor staff access, we require a subprocessor addendum and likely recommend Private deployment. I'll draft an addendum template; legal needs vendor attestation to proceed.

nora_sales: Action items: 1) @kai_infra region matrix 2) @beth_se BYO-KMS runbook + IAM 3) @omar_presales two quotes with uplift 4) @lina_legal draft addendum + link to SR-2026-900. Deliverables by Tue EOD so we can hand to procurement.

kai_infra: Routing snippet to show procurement: policy: pin_tenant=true; primary=EU; standby_within=EU; global_fallback=disabled; consent_required=true

beth_se: Uploaded BYO-KMS runbook draft, will paste curl in 30m.

omar_presales: Draft quotes posted to drive, will attach link in thread once RevOps thumbs-up.

lina_legal: Addendum draft started. Noting lead times in the packet. I'll sync with security on SR-2026-900.

nora_sales: Thanks — please drop final artifacts here and I'll bundle them. :thumbsup:
